## Upgrade checklist

1. Review the upstream API, browser support and CSP notes.
2. Replace `hyalite.js`, update the commit and SHA above, and retain the upstream license.
3. Run the web unit tests and production build.
4. Verify supported Chromium refraction and CSS fallback in Safari/Firefox.
5. Verify scrolling, keyboard, rotation and safe-area behavior in Android WebView.
